limitations: Q1 balance and NAV as of June 30; price and buyback through October 23. Not a refreshed Oct23 NAV.

Issuer NAV uses average of at least two international shipping-broker appraisals per ship as disclosed on page 45 of original issuer presentation. We have not independently inspected individual broker valuations.
Net cash residual approach is algebraic, not a ship-by-ship valuation and includes non-fleet net assets and obligations.
Q1 per-share denominator predates Sept/Oct buyback; share cancellation, cash spent and ex dividend need exact pro forma before any investment.
Further VLGC, Kamsarmax and Suezmax commitments lack disclosed contract prices and committed payments.
All scenario exit P/NAV ratios and haircuts are stress assumptions, not calibrated forecasts.
No dividends after Q1, tax, FX, costs, dilution, opportunity cost, probability or time path modeled.
Underwriting not tied to existing H-series prospective source/return data.
Company reports normalized consolidated net cash Rs 7,726cr after NCD/currency-swap adjustments versus reported Rs 8,056cr; scenarios use unadjusted Rs 8,056cr and need an alternative reconciliation.
